name: Mr. DONUTS #2 Kenneth City
address_source: Google Business Profile (gmaps_detail.js on the place URL).
language_evidence: All verbatim Google reviews collected (Sandra Martin, Paris Amor, Marina Grampietro, Lori S, Michael E Doane) are in English.
has_own_site_evidence: (1) gmaps_detail.js on the live Google Business Profile returned website: null (no 'Website' button / no data-item-id=authority link). (2) curl -I on mrdonutskennethcity.com, mrdonuts2.com and mrdonutsflorida.com: all failed with connect_unreachable / no public DNS record. (3) WebSearch '"Mr. DONUTS" Kenneth City FL facebook instagram email' and '"Mr Donuts" "Kenneth City" website' both returned no official site; only third-party directory listings (Atly, a Fox13 News segment) and unrelated chains (Dunkin', other "Mr. Donuts" locations in other states/countries). No Wix/Squarespace/GoDaddy Sites/WordPress presence found.

social_media.evidence: WebSearch for Facebook/Instagram turned up nothing for this specific Kenneth City location. The only independent confirmation of the business is a Fox 13 News video segment describing it as a donut, pastry and boba tea shop open daily from 5 AM at 5400 58th St N.

email_search_note: No public email found. Checked: Google Business Profile (no email field), WebSearch for Facebook/Instagram/linktree (none found for this business), domain guesses (no DNS record at all, so no domain-based email either). Consistent with small walk-in food businesses that rely on phone/walk-in only.

google_business.hours: 5 AM to 2 PM, every day (per live Google Business Profile and confirmed by a Fox 13 News segment: 'Mr. Donuts opens at 5 a.m. seven days a week').

research_note_important: The Google Business listing's auto-aggregated 'serviceMentions' field initially surfaced items like 'honey cake', 'pirozhki', 'borscht' and 'napoleon cake' (Eastern European bakery items). Cross-checking against the actual photo gallery and verbatim reviews showed this is stale data from a PREVIOUS business at this address (an Eastern European pastry shop, photos of handwritten price tags for 'Biscotti', 'Honey Cookies', 'Palmiers' etc. were downloaded but excluded from the gallery as not representative of the current business). The current reviews are unanimous and recent, describing fresh donuts, apple fritters, breakfast sandwiches/burritos, kolaches and croissants under what one reviewer calls 'new ownership'. Only photos and facts matching the CURRENT donut-shop business were used on the site.

services.note: No prices published anywhere (Google Business Profile, reviews, or web search). Site uses 'Ask in-store' framing per the adapted-variant rule, never an invented price list.
donuts: Specialty flavors (customers specifically mention a 'Dubai donut')

services_source: Verbatim Google reviews (gmaps_reviews.js) plus a Fox 13 News video segment describing the shop ('sells doughnuts, pastries, and boba teas... specialty boba teas and other coffee drinks to go').

reviews_verbatim.name: Sandra Martin
reviews_verbatim.text: Found this place today by accident, and definitely glad we did! Best breakfast burritos I've ever had! MADE FRESH!! Donuts were great, and we also ordered a kolache. We will for sure be going back!
reviews_verbatim.source: Google (trimmed at the point Google's UI truncated the review with an ellipsis; no words added).

reviews_verbatim.name: Paris Amor
reviews_verbatim.text: Fresh baked, good ingredients, quality, clean food. Hard to find a cafe donut shop that makes everything from scratch and they do! Delicious every time, and good breakfast sandwiches and croissants! The Dubai donut is my favorite donut!

reviews_verbatim.name: Marina Grampietro
reviews_verbatim.text: I love donuts and I wanted to try a new donut place and this popped up in my maps and it was close by. They have fresh glazed donuts, and as someone with an obsession with glazed donuts, I obviously took some home.
reviews_verbatim.source: Google (trimmed at the point Google's UI truncated the review with an ellipsis; no words added).

gallery_excluded.reason: Visually confirmed (viewed each photo) to belong to the PREVIOUS business at this address (a European pastry/deli case with handwritten price tags for biscotti, honey cookies, palmiers, and plated pastries with a 'European Pastry in Florida' sign). Excluded entirely: using them would misrepresent the current donut shop.

brand_vibe: Warm citrus/amber palette (accent-deep #c76a1f, accent-mid #e2954f) on a light cream base, chosen to echo the orange display case and warm, cheerful signage seen in the real storefront photos. New palette not reused from prior builds.
